destructiveReset.title: Delete encrypted data and start over
destructiveReset.intro: This is not recovery. This action cannot be undone and will:
destructiveReset.account: delete every authenticator account in your Personal Vault;
destructiveReset.keys: delete keys and ciphertext that can no longer be unlocked;
destructiveReset.memberships: remove you from Shared Vaults where you are a Viewer; and
destructiveReset.services: require you to reset 2FA on the original services and add each account again.
destructiveReset.boundary: Shared Vaults owned by other people and their members' data will not be deleted. Copies or secrets already obtained by another browser cannot be erased remotely.
destructiveReset.confirmationMismatch: The confirmation phrase does not match.
destructiveReset.invalid: The server rejected the confirmation phrase. Type it exactly as displayed.

destructiveReset.cleanupError: The server reset completed and the vault was locked, but device data could not be cleared. Remove this browser's site data before continuing.
destructiveReset.confirmDescription: Every account, key, and encrypted Personal Vault value will be destroyed. This action cannot be undone.
